title: THE CIRCUS · KETTLEBELL LAPS
why: Same gauntlet style, eight kettlebell stations that have never been on a card: cleans that circle the body, presses from the bottom of a squat, flips, catches and kneeling windmills. Four laps for time with a flat leg off every lap.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 7 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A + I.A.H. prep · shoulders / spine / hips

items.name: Scorpion taps ×8/side
items.detail: face down, heel taps the floor across the body

items.name: Adduction hip rocks ×10/side
items.detail: one leg out to the side, rock back

items.name: Circular clean 35 lb ×3/side
items.detail: groove the catch before the clock

blocks.title: THE CIRCUS · 4 LAPS FOR TIME
blocks.meta: FOR TIME · 4 LAPS · 8 stations + 1 flat leg per lap · cap 27:00 · 35 / 45 / 52 lb
blocks.format: One clock. A lap is the eight stations in order, then the belt. Move straight through; rest only where you have to. Record the total time for 4 laps, the station that cost the most, and RPE.
blocks.workRest: LEG every lap: 0.15 mi at 8.5 mph flat (about 1:04), then straight back to station 1. Lap 4 at 9.0 if laps 1 to 3 were under 6:00 each.

items.name: S1 · Circular clean 35 lb ×6/side
items.detail: bell circles around the outside of the body and lands in the rack

items.name: S2 · Sots press 35 lb ×5/side
items.detail: sit in the bottom of the squat, press from the rack to lockout, stay down

items.name: S3 · Around-the-world with hand catch 35 lb ×8 each way
items.detail: pass the bell around the body, release and catch it behind the back

items.name: S4 · Dual kneeling windmill 45 lb ×5/side
items.detail: both knees down, bell locked out overhead, reach the free hand to the floor

items.name: S5 · Tray squat 35 lb ×8/side
items.detail: bell balanced flat on the palm overhead like a tray, squat to depth

items.name: S6 · Lawnmower clean 52 lb DB ×6/side
items.detail: staggered stance, pull from outside the front foot across to the rack

items.name: S7 · Simple flip and catch 35 lb ×10
items.detail: flip the bell one full turn by the horns, catch the handle, soft knees

items.name: S8 · Overhead lunge 35 lb ×6/side
items.detail: bell locked out overhead the whole set, reverse lunge

items.name: LEG · RUN 0.15 mi @ 8.5 flat · every lap

blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 3 laps, Sots press ×3/side, windmills with the 35, belt at 7.5.
blocks.text: Circular clean: sweep the bell out and around the hip like an around-the-world, and let it land in the rack instead of passing to the other hand. Sots press: squat to the bottom, hold it, press the bell up and down without standing. Hand catch: as the bell passes behind you, let go with one hand and catch with the other. Flip: start from a two-hand hold at the waist, pop the bell up so the handle turns a full circle, catch the handle. Lawnmower clean: like starting a mower, pull across the body into the rack.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · Turkish sit-up + birddog shoulder tap + abduction press windmill · straight through

items.name: Turkish sit-up 35 lb ×6/side
items.detail: roll up to the elbow, then the hand, then sit tall; back down slow

items.name: Birddog shoulder taps ×8/side
items.detail: on all fours, opposite leg out, tap the shoulder

items.name: Abduction press windmill 35 lb ×5/side
items.detail: standing, bell overhead, lift the free leg out to the side as you hinge
